title: A state off-road area on the old ranch
text: The Eastern Kern County Onyx Ranch State Vehicular Recreation Area became a state off-highway vehicle area in 2014. It covers about 25,000 acres, and it offers riding for motorcycles, all-terrain vehicles, and four-wheel-drive vehicles. Visitors also use it for rock hounding, bird and wildlife viewing, and hunting. It is about 0.5 percent of Kern County, as of 2024.
